D05.reason: No predetermined blob pairs, spanning tree or fixed destinations.

V01.reason: Dense close-view interior merges into a blob; individual routes are not adequately resolved.

V04.reason: Regular bead chains coexist with diffuse crowded areas; the reference has more legible irregular fine strands.

V05.reason: Dense patches exist, but their interiors fail the required resolved-curve condition.

V06.reason: Some routes connect nearby branches; no convincing hierarchy of thin links between resolved dense patches.

V07.reason: Large voids exist; patch interiors are too uniformly thick.

V08.reason: Bush-like accumulations have abrupt transitions and insufficient variation in internal structure.

V09.reason: Oblique view confirms shallow extent with vertical excursions; reference depth distribution is not matched.

V10.reason: Multi-candle groups are solid cuboids, missing separate narrow silhouettes and height variation.

V11.reason: 574 rods versus 7336 candles; rods are visible, but close branch readability is poor.

V12.reason: 56 full-block centers in the wide frame versus the user estimate of roughly five.

V13.reason: Bright and faint objects and lavender/cream colors exist; excess sources alter local illumination and generated marks appear warmer than the close reference.

V15.reason: Scaffold occupied-cell footprint spans [217, 55, 249] blocks (coordinate spans plus one). All candidates also use the revised distance55 close camera, based on two reference cube sizes. V16.reason: Whole views inspected, but no dedicated endpoint/boundary crop review yet.

new_findings.finding: placement-42 reduces star fill but leaves the same angular, crowded routes. Material/count improvement is not a geometry improvement.

new_findings.finding: Current branching recursively scales child lifetime from parent lifetime. Lengthening trunks therefore enlarges local bushes too; uniform branch opportunity rules give weak patch-to-corridor transitions.

new_findings.next_test: Separate continuing path reach from local branch lifetime/activity; do not preselect blob centers or destinations.
